title: Moonlight Adventure
creator: Alicia Tan
description: A colourful 2D short animation about a young explorer travelling through a magical night world.
process: The production started with storyboarding and character sketches. The artwork was then prepared digitally before frame-by-frame animation, background movement, sound effects and final colour adjustments were added.

title: Robot Workshop
creator: Jason Lee
description: A 3D modelling and animation project showing a futuristic robot workshop.
process: The robot was modelled from basic shapes before materials and lighting were added. Keyframe animation was then used to create mechanical movement.

title: Campus Stories
creator: Nur Aina
description: A cinematic campus montage using transitions, titles, sound and colour grading.
process: Video clips were selected and arranged in Premiere Pro. The team then added animated titles, transitions, background music and colour correction.

title: Neon City
creator: Chloe Wong
description: A cyberpunk-inspired digital artwork focusing on perspective and dramatic lighting.
process: The composition was sketched with perspective guides. Buildings and signs were created in layers before glow and atmospheric effects were added.

title: Ocean Friends
creator: Daniel Ong
description: A friendly educational 2D animation featuring sea animals and simple motion graphics.
process: Characters were designed using simple shapes and colours. Motion paths, reusable symbols and sound effects were added to create a cheerful learning experience.

title: Mini Space Station
creator: Ethan Goh
description: A stylised low-poly 3D environment featuring a small space station.
process: The space station was modelled using low-poly techniques. Materials and lighting were added before an animated camera path was created.
